text:
Sales people hate wrestling with their CRMs! No one likes a chore of typing in the notes, so your client interaction data is never fresh.

This product is brilliant! It makes updating the CRM and pulling data insights easy and intuitive. With CRM Chat your sales people are free to focus on what they do best -- selling.

If your organization uses a CRM, you salespeople should try CRM Chat.
Yes, I might be biased :) But I use the CRM chat a lot. Mainly to send updates on leads and tasks in my HubSpot via WhatsApp voice messages.
Powerful and best because I have experience and I use in practical life

We use CRMChat every day to sell our services and those of our customers. The app works well, and our entire team and customer teams use it. It's good that proxies are thought out here. Thanks to Gleb and the team!
